workstreams.name: Provider connection verification
workstreams.bank_verification: Read-only Brankas GET /v1/statements validates credential without consent, import or reconciliation.
workstreams.etax_verification: Read-only provider health endpoint or auth handshake; otherwise remains configured-unverified instead of fabricating verification.
workstreams.verification_receipt: Provider metadata/profile records verification status, attempt time, successful verification time and bounded error detail.

workstreams.name: Centralized connection health and durable verification evidence
workstreams.settings_overview: Finance Settings shows bank feeds, Thailand e-Tax and client email with exact current readiness and next action.
workstreams.verification_history: Every real provider verification attempt is append-only evidence with provider, status, verification mode, timestamp and bounded error/detail.
workstreams.latest_state: Provider credential metadata and durable verification event are updated atomically through one service-role RPC.
workstreams.secret_protection: Verification detail rejects secret fields and secret references.

workstreams.name: Finance scale integrity closure
workstreams.legal_entity_uniqueness: Exact organization-scoped indexed conflict lookups replace the bounded 1000-row scan; database normalized unique indexes remain the race-safe backstop.
workstreams.correction_duplicate_preflight: Exact JSON correction identity is filtered before limit; database active-correction unique index remains authoritative.
workstreams.correction_account_selector: Complete paginated chart-of-accounts population replaces the prior 1000-row cap.

workstreams.name: Client portal population integrity
workstreams.work_status: Engagement runs and work items use complete paginated populations rather than 200/5000 row caps.
workstreams.open_requests: Open client requests and evidence use complete batched populations rather than 200/1000 row caps.
workstreams.tax_filings: Client-visible filing truth uses complete Finance populations rather than a 100-row cap.
workstreams.messages: Display remains intentionally bounded, but exact total/has-more are exposed and all unread firm messages are marked read across the full engagement scope.
